XL model progress — 13 October 2026

**521 XL models: 234 installed, 287 remaining. No new installations in this checkpoint.**

- Upton: full tower and podium clearance passed in all four coordinate representations. Its 64 saved height samples and unchanged overlap validator passed. Four foreign coverage gaps remain. The corrected location script passed preparation and is unexecuted.
- PolyU Sports Centre: the 3,214-triangle saved terrain candidate passed all 6,701 sampled height checks and the raw validator. Nine BASIC buildings show increased sampled base-to-ground gaps; the existing campus model still needs its full mesh check. The saved-height diagnostic passed five fixtures, import and preflight, with exact candidate/parent coordinate bindings. Its actual-source calculation is unexecuted.
- Citywalk: the numerical investigation finished in three coordinate representations, retaining 683 seeds, 598 local grade diagnostics and 71 support paths each. Receipt recovery is prepared following a reservation collision. The bounded follow-up support-path script passed ten adverse fixtures and isolated import; actual-source work requires the completed receipt.
- Southside: the revised source-terrain helper passed 25 fixtures. Its constructor passed import, runtime closure and read-only preflight. Actual terrain construction is unexecuted.

Reviewed code and evidence are pushed in [b80c8b3b7](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/b80c8b3b7), [397dd04e8](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/397dd04e8), [192c22279](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/192c22279), [7507c6359](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/7507c6359), [4eb043616](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/4eb043616) and [070370cdf](https://github.com/wiiiimm/hongkong-sandbox/commit/070370cdf).

Original government building geometry is unchanged. Zero AI geometry modelling. Diagnostics do not count as installations; acquisition acceptance and optimisation approval remain separate. New model workers are awaiting clarification of an automatic approval review that still cites the earlier database-migration pause. Read-only auditing and code preparation have continued. The goal remains to resolve all 287 remaining XL models.
